manifest_scope_note: Covers all 32 DISP-003 panel symbols. MATICUSDT (delisted 2024-09) and EOSUSDT (delisted 2025-05) have no October 2026 archive zips (HTTP 404 for every month after their delisting), so their klines panels end at their last tradeable date; their funding panels carry the final published funding rows. All other symbols extend through 2026-10-31.
